description: List dynamic configs. Returns a single page of configs ordered by `updated_at desc, id desc`. Each row includes the latest published `version` per env and any active drafts.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned in the previous page's `next_cursor`. Omit for the first page.

q.description: Case-insensitive substring filter across the resource's human-readable text columns (e.g. `name`, `title`, `description`). OR-matched across those columns; omit to return everything.

name: release_configs_list
